sources.title: Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases ...
sources.snippet: A: The model supports 8,192 tokens maximum. This includes both the input prompt and generated output combined. For longer documents, you must split them and process separately or use Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 which extends context to 32k tokens. Q: Is this model actively maintained? A: This is the v0.1 release from Mistral AI's initial launch.

sources.title: mistral:7b-instruct - Ollama
sources.snippet: Mistral is a 7B parameter model, distributed with the Apache license. It is available in both instruct (instruction following) and text completion. The Mistral AI team has noted that Mistral 7B: Outperforms Llama 2 13B on all benchmarks Outperforms Llama 1 34B on many benchmarks Approaches CodeLlama 7B performance on code, while remaining good at English tasks Versions

sources.title: Model Card for Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1
sources.snippet: The Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1 Large Language Model (LLM) is a instruct fine-tuned version of the Mistral-7B-v0.1 generative text model using a variety of publicly available conversation datasets.
